title: Trump’s Tariffs Are Damaging America’s Biggest Foreign Source of Screws

title: Leaders promised to cut climate pollution, then doubled down on fossil fuels

title: Santos Starts Barossa Project Days After Failed $19 Billion Sale
summary: Santos Ltd. has begun production at its $4.5 billion Barossa field off northern Australia, a move toward a much-anticipated increase in output as the group recovers from a third failed takeover bid under its current boss, Kevin Gallagher.
